title: Understanding the Task
text: To determine the growth rate of yeast cells, we need to estimate a parameter based on observed data. This involves using statistical methods to infer the growth rate from the data collected.

title: Identifying the Statistical Problem
text: What statistical method would you use to infer a parameter from observed data?

title: Differentiating Between Statistical Problems
text: Estimation involves determining a parameter's value based on sample data. Prediction involves forecasting future outcomes based on current data. Causal inference involves determining the cause-and-effect relationship between variables.
